fields.description:
DATA-QUALITY ISSUES, NOT INTEGRATION BLOCKERS. The integration can be designed, built and tested independently of these. They do block the point at which live Airtable data can be migrated, so work them in PARALLEL, not at the end.

WagerTech input needed (workbook tabs in brackets):

* C1 Five duplicate link codes within the same deal \[Links rows 377&418, 425&428, 479-481&498-500\]: TOONIEBET-CTM-ON-CAS 662608019V16; HORSESHOE-C-US-CAS BOUNTY (USA1); HOLLYWOODCASINO-GD-AB-CAS UNLOCK1/2/3. Genuine duplicates to merge, or different links sharing a code?

* C2 Seven links with no resolvable deal \[Links rows 208, 210, 211, 214, 215, 426, 546\]: five Hardrock-C (CAS1-CAS5), one BOUNTY (USA1), one 1751123. Which deal, or retire?

* C3 49 distinct codes appear on more than one deal across 545 rows. We assume this is expected — confirm, because if not it is a data problem to fix pre-migration

* C4 Three Rebet-CTM rep/deal pairs with two simultaneously active assignments on the same NXTLVL link. Need end-dating before migration (see BUILD-98)

* C5 22 long link codes, 80-112 chars, DraftKings and Golden Nugget — look like concatenated btag tokens. What does Ops actually call these links?

* C6 Vertical value set — three systems hold three different lists. A deal has EXACTLY ONE vertical; we need the single authoritative value list. Blocks the Deal picklist, BUILD-86 readiness, and migration. Also tracked as BUILD-78

* C7 Authoritative active partner-and-book combinations by state (see BUILD-101)

* C8 Alberta market value (see BUILD-101)

* C9 296 assignments with Airtable status 'Replaced', no Salesforce equivalent. Mapped to Ended on the basis that history preserves what replaced what — confirm, or we add 'Replaced' to keep fidelity

Jumpr effort 6-10h plus WagerTech cleanup.

Workbook: Wagertech Airtable → Salesforce Migration Workbook (Mapping Assessment + Review Items tabs).

Source: CMS Integration Design v1, §9.
